ecu_export_after_flash.verdict: Tune on the ECU is iter_6. Earlier hypothesis of bad flash was incorrect.

invalid_pulls.evidence: RPM rate 530-540 rpm/s vs 760-820 rpm/s on healthy iter_3 and iter_6 _31-33; same MAP/TPS/displacement/AFF=unity ruled out tune/sensor/adaptive causes; user identified dragging rear brake.

vs_iter_3_baseline.interpretation: iter_6 makes +3 hp over iter_3 with leaner combustion target -- AE fix improved transient AFR control without losing peak power. Tune is HEALTHIER than iter_3.

concerns: Rear injector duty hits 93.5% at 5500-6000 RPM (pull _31). Approaching saturation ceiling. Any further VE increase or RPM extension risks running out of injector.

AFR is now slightly lean of where this bike made best power on iter_3 (12.6-12.8 vs 11.5-11.7). Tune is safe on knock (0 retard) but power gain is modest. Could try an iter_7 spark sweep or accept this as the WOT target for the street tune.
notes: iter_6 = AE table fix only (mid-decay boost, remove 0.91 tail enleanment). WOT VE trim from iter_5 has been REVERTED. POST-FLASH VALIDATION (2026-05-12 brake-fixed run): three independent pulls show 94.5/95.1/95.2 hp, 0 knock, AFR 11.97-12.76, well-controlled. Tune VALIDATED. Pulls _25-28 are loaded-data pulls due to dragging rear brake; do not use for free-accel HP claims.
